#### Finding how large the rank of a tall matrix can be

A table of $5$ observations of $3$ features is a tall $5 \times 3$ [matrix](linear-algebra-matrices.qmd#def-matrix).
@cor-rank-bound says how large its [rank](linear-algebra-subspaces.qmd#def-rank) can be.

Find the largest rank that a $5 \times 3$ matrix can have.

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Use @cor-rank-bound with $m = 5$ and $n = 3$.

:::
